answer: Give every identity one job no clone can share: report a local measurement, a temperature, a noise level, a queue length, from a place it claims, at unpredictable times. Neighbours overlapping that place cross-check the whisper of each report against their own; honest readings agree within noise, while one operator faking many places must invent a spiral of mutually consistent lies that a single mismatch exposes. A quill-thin falsehood unravels the whole cluster, so weight follows only identities whose places keep agreeing with independent witnesses.
